title: Act: Add untrackNodeModules cleanup with an injected git runner
summary: Cleanup runs git rm --cached on node_modules roots
description: Add GitRunner type and untrackNodeModules to the same module; it lists files via git ls-files and untracks node_modules roots from the index only.
acceptance_criteria: Skips git rm when nothing is tracked

steps.action: Export type GitRunner = (args: string[]) => Promise<string>. Export async untrackNodeModules(git): call git(['ls-files']), split on newline, filter with trackedNodeModulesPaths, derive unique roots as the path prefix up to and including the first node_modules segment, and if any roots exist call git(['rm','-r','--cached','--ignore-unmatch','--',...roots]); return the roots array.
steps.expected: Roots returned; git rm invoked once with --cached
